Neutralize Poison
(Necromancy)

Level: 4
Sphere: Healing
Range: Touch
Duration: 1 turn/level
Casting Time: 1
Area of Effect: 1 creature
Saving Throw: None

This spell removes all toxins from the body, both natural and magical in nature. When this spell is cast upon an individual, it immediately neutralizes any poison and renders the target immune to poison for 1 turn per level of the caster.
